plugin.name: AI workbench
plugin.description: Analyze a result with an AI model after looking at exactly what will be sent; propose SQL for other plugins. Sensitive data is masked first.
field.request.hint: Edit freely. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
field.name: Name
info.tokens: About {tokens} tokens will be sent (an estimate).
info.policy.off: AI is turned off in this environment.
info.policy.preview: This environment asks you to look before sending.
info.policy.allow: This environment lets requests without data go at once.
request.title: Analysis request
request.task.default: Analyze the result below. Point out anything notable or unusual and what to check next.
note.rows: Only the first {shown} of {total} rows are included.
note.cells: Emails and long numbers are masked; cells are cut at {max} characters.
note.text: The text is cut at {max} characters.
system.analyze: You are a careful data analyst. Answer in the language of the task. Use Markdown. Say what you are unsure of.
system.sql: You write one SQL statement. Reply with a single SELECT or WITH statement only, in one code block, no explanation. Use only the tables and columns you were given.
generate.title: Write one SQL statement
message.nothingToKeep: There is no answer to save yet.
setting.sensitiveColumns.hint: Comma separated; those columns are masked as a whole. password, token, secret, email, phone and the like are always masked.
setting.docFolder.hint: A folder you authorized for files. Markdown and text files in it become reference documents.
setting.docBudget.hint: At most this much of reference documents is added to a request.
error.policyOff: AI is turned off in this environment.
error.noConnection: No AI connection is set. Choose one in the AI workbench settings.
error.connectionMissingEnv: The AI connection “{connection}” (from the environment) was not found.
error.connectionMissingDefault: The AI connection “{connection}” (the workspace default) was not found.
error.noProvider: “{connection}” is not an AI connection that can chat.
error.noRun: There is no result to analyze.
error.badKind: Only SQL can be written for now.
error.folderNotAuthorized: “{folder}” is not a folder you authorized.
error.chat.auth: The AI service refused the key. {message}
error.chat.rateLimit: The AI service is limiting requests. Try again in {seconds} s.
error.chat.overloaded: The AI service is busy. Try again later.
error.chat.timeout: The AI service did not answer in time.
error.chat.tooLong: The request is too long for the model. Remove documents or rows.
error.chat.network: The AI service could not be reached. {message}
field.connection.hint: Empty: the environment's, then the workspace default.
error.noArtifacts: This version cannot attach an analysis to a run.
message.noRun: The run this analysis came from is not known.
error.connectionMissingSettings: The AI connection “{connection}” (from the AI workbench settings) was not found.
error.connectionMissingPage: The AI connection “{connection}” was not found.
settings.note: Nothing to set here. This item only lets other plugins (like SQL's “Write with AI”) call the AI workbench. Choose the default connection in the plugin settings.
setting.connection.hint: Used when neither the page nor the environment's ai.connection names one. Any connection of a provider plugin.
